issue_request: FHIR-6214 was a Published FHIR-core CarePlan change request from DSTU1, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking that CarePlan.activity.detail.product support diet and nutritional supplements by changing detail.product from Reference(Medication | Substance) to CodeableConcept | Reference(Medication | Substance).
initial_application: The Jira comment records SVN #6766. Git commit d6c4981fa8fe7d58cc3e1cc393aa8cc0b6a83c54 is the corresponding git-svn build@6766 commit, and its CarePlan spreadsheet patch changes CarePlan.activity.detail.product to CarePlan.activity.detail.product[x] with type CodeableConcept | Reference(Medication|Substance).
additional_context: CarePlan is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source has the successor element CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail.product[x], with CodeableConcept plus Reference targets Medication and Substance. Later Published issue FHIR-26064 renamed CarePlan.activity.detail to CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail for R5, explaining the current path. Current plannedActivityReference also includes NutritionOrder, but that later adjacent functionality does not change the FHIR-6214 datatype check.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active CarePlan StructureDefinition already preserves the requested CodeableConcept choice and the Medication/Substance references on CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail.product[x].
